name: Dongjian Insight Reporter
description: An insight-report specialist backed by the existing OpenClaw dongjian agent. It turns an AI news digest into evidence-based summaries, analysis, bank response strategies, and an HTML email.

skills.name: Insight report writing
skills.description: Crawls every article from a digest_url, writes fact summaries, key analysis and bank response strategies, then prepares or sends the HTML report to recipient.
examples: Generate and send an insight report from digest_url=https://example.com/digest to recipient=user@example.com
